mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3)

SELECT recent.`date`, recent.`count`, recent.amount FROM ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS `count`, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM `order` GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY `date` DESC LIMIT 7 ) recent ORDER BY recent.`date`
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = #{newStatus} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{oldStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `order` WHERE status = 0 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
